variants.transformation: Shard the single-channel embedding before four-way repeat; preserve global-mask input and local ID/premix alignment.
variants.argument: S_p pad(E repeated4)=repeat4(S_p pad(E)); identical value/copy map including padding zeros. Source still needs a full initial four-channel residual at its eventual HCpost consumer.
variants.conditions: Maintain no-pad clone/custom-op alias contract, contiguous local layout, original mask values and all bank lifetimes. Logical output-byte reduction is not measured traffic or peak memory.

variants.transformation: Replace full-row embedding SUM AllReduce followed by SP shard with a correctly padded SUM ReduceScatter, then local repeat.
variants.argument: For masked vocab contributions E_r, S_p pad(sum_r E_r)=sum_r S_p pad(E_r). Current plan output reduction and SP use the TP group in the reviewed domains; required PCP/token exchange stays before this transformation.
variants.conditions: Same rank order/group and token rows, zero padding, dtype/reduction numerical contract and all embedding observers required. Padding can offset communication savings for small N.

variants.transformation: Publish local IDs and padding mask together with existing input metadata or local embedding publication.
variants.argument: SP IDs/mask are deterministic slices/pad of the same original global generation. A shared producer may supply those views rather than independent private pad/cast/copy stages.
variants.conditions: Preserve incoming non-None mask values, global outputs still needed by embedding/KV, rejected/anchor/DCP metadata effects and original captured banks. Linked to existing F31, not a new candidate.

variants.transformation: Delay materialization of identical initial HC channels through first-pre consumers and reconstruct the required residual at first-post or keep a suitable view.
variants.argument: The first HC state is a logical four-channel broadcast of one embedding row. Layout representation can be specialized if every first-pre and first-post read is represented.
variants.conditions: Full initial residual is still required. Existing operator may require contiguous storage; new view/tiling/alias interface and all numerical paths remain conditional, overlapping local-repeat and F02.

variants.transformation: Prune local row-local HC/FFN arithmetic for provably dead padding while retaining original collective ABI and global model-parallel work.
variants.argument: N10 pads to16 physical rows and N20 to24 under TP8 shard; selected noQ patterns show reachable empty local query domains.
variants.conditions: NoQ does not prove an entire rank dead. Keep globalKV, head AllToAll, Wo_a/Wo_b, collective participation, MC2 uniform domains, output padding and all possible observers. No row count alone establishes safe pruning.

variants.transformation: Use the draft initial broadcast/onehot pre_mix contract to specialize first-pre y and/or coefficient input projection.
variants.argument: Current104first entries are source-consistent initial repeats plus FP32 onehot premix. A real-algebra coefficient prefold or y shortcut can be considered only within a specified numerical domain.
variants.conditions: Do not delete data-dependent coefficients needed by HCpost/next premix. Infinity times zero, NaN payload, signed zero, accumulation and BF16/native rounding can defeat an unconditional y=E shortcut.

variants.transformation: Tile HCpost into the next HCpre/norm consumer, with explicit residual and premix outputs at both attention/FFN and layer boundaries.
variants.argument: Current common decoder returns hidden and ffn_pre and retains post state as a later residual; producer/consumer stages may share loads or tiles while emitting required state.
variants.conditions: The complete HC residual is not dead merely because next pre consumes it. Preserve current scaling, rounded add, collective finalization, separate pre_mix and last-layer collapse. F23/F04 effects are not additive.

variants.transformation: Compute512D KV/norm/RoPE at SP row owners before full5120D hidden gather; exchange KV and keep local Q_a where CP-query ownership matches.
variants.argument: KV is a row-local replicated-weight map. Under exact SP-to-CP row ownership, global cache consumers can receive512D values while Q reads its own normalized rows.
variants.conditions: CP start/num_actual/per_rank and FlashComm suffix are real metadata, not inferred solely from ceil(N/8). Preserve global cache writes on noQ ranks, positions/slots, parameter generations and all full-hidden observers.

variants.transformation: Compute local BF16 Q_a1280 and KV512 before gather, optionally as a1792-output joint contraction; route/select Q_a by the CP query map and publish global KV.
variants.argument: Both Wq_a and Wkv are declared ReplicatedLinear. A packed local row map can publish separate1280D Q_a and512D KV results instead of5120D hidden; Qnorm/quant/Q_b and each KV norm remain separate.
variants.conditions: This changes current unequal-M layout rather than claiming naive existing-input concatenation. Preserve BF16 contraction barriers, exact row mapping/duplicates, collective/new-launch costs and live parameters. Linked to F06; alternative to the512-only aligned-owner case.

variants.transformation: Prepare context KV lazily per layer and pack its rows with that layer query KV rows into one same-weight WKV contraction when both inputs are ready.
variants.argument: Context bank main_norm rows and query input_layernorm rows are different inputs to the same layer attn.wkv. Row concatenation computes the two independent maps; no input-value equality is required.
variants.conditions: Keep distinct row/position/slot metadata and512D norms/RoPE, context-before-query duplicate-write order, noncausal cache readiness and dummy/no-context domains. Changed-M tiling needs a precision contract. Joint preparation may delay the first ready layer; overlap/savings are not free or additive.

logical_domain_examples.note: Illustrative ring/allgather payload convention and logical tensor output extents; not physical traffic, peak allocation, causal benefit or per-request pairing.

invalid_shortcuts: Native N10/20 query rows are not F27 context12/24 or target aux24 rows. Never transfer row plans by equal counts.
No localQ does not imply no globalKV or no output rank contribution: restore_tp_heads can deliver valid-token head shards to that rank.
Existing localQ_a M2/3 and globalKV M10/20 cannot be naively concatenated as identical input domains. F32 alternatives explicitly change ownership/interfaces.
Replacing full embedding AllReduce with padded ReduceScatter has payload ratio ceil(N/P)*P/(2N) under the illustrative ring convention; for N1,P8 it is4, not universally a reduction.
Initial onehot premix does not make all HCpre outputs constant or prove floating-point y identity for every special value.
Context and query KV share a layer weight but differ in hidden-state provenance. Equal slot/position does not justify reusing one for the other across accepted/rolled-back iterations.
Current output path already writes projected result into the caller buffer. Do not count a hypothetical second full hidden output copy as a new removal.
relationships: F28 local repeat, ReduceScatter/local embedding and broadcast residual overlap the same repeat/pad materialization; jointly count once.
F02 draft first-pre specialization and F28 broadcast representation are dependent variants, not independent full-repeat savings.
F32 aligned512-only and dual1792 projected exchange are ownership alternatives. Nominal feature ratios10 and20/7 are not speedups.
Context/query WKV row packing can compose only after resolving row ownership/epochs; keeping full-hidden gather removes the corresponding F32 communication claim.
F03 decoder boundary composition retains F23 merge/finalization and existing F04 dual-output rounding; avoid double-counting their intermediates.
Padding row pruning preserves all collective participation and global model-parallel work; zero-query branch is already implemented.
